hypothesis: Completed-season TrackMan profiles of the pitches a batter is offered encode target-free pitch-selection and approach information that is absent from exact C's pitcher-only physical profile. Overall, pitcher-hand-conditional, and count-conditional batter profiles may improve R control probabilities without observing the current pitch.

data_rules.identity_mapping_cutoff: exact linkage rows with season strictly before the query season
data_rules.profile_cutoff: raw TrackMan rows with season strictly before the query season

candidate.model: exact C CatBoost MultiClass reverse_any, unchanged 500/depth6/lr0.05/l2=12/seed2026
candidate.overall: batter sample size, four pitch-group rates, and mean/std for eight physical measurements
candidate.pitcher_hand_condition: K=80 shrinkage of four pitch-group rates and eight physical means toward each batter overall profile
candidate.count_condition: K=120 shrinkage of four pitch-group rates toward each batter overall profile
candidate.raw_pitcher_id: dropped exactly as in parent C

route_and_selection.route: R only; F remains exact parent
route_and_selection.selection: maximize the minimum R score gain over 2020 and 2021; ties use median R gain then smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: freeze gamma and rerun the identical recipe on 2022 and 2023
source_gate.on_fail: close batter TrackMan profile axis before opening 2022+

goal_completion: This source gate can never complete the Goal.
